name: SpringBoardGame
tagline: 使用已安装 App 图标，在主屏幕上游玩六款小游戏。
description: 主屏幕游戏提供贪吃蛇、俄罗斯方块、篮球、打砖块、足球和坦克六款小游戏，并共用一次长按启动与游戏选择界面。
各游戏会把已安装 App 的图标变成蛇身、方块、篮球、砖块、球员或敌人，结束后可再次游玩或恢复原主屏幕。
notice: 🎮 长按主屏幕底部的 Search 按钮或页面指示器，然后从六款游戏中选择一款。安装本插件时会自动替换已安装的 IconSnake 与 IconTetris。
features: 长按后选择六款主屏幕小游戏
使用已安装 App 的图标作为游戏元素
贪吃蛇支持滑动转向、成长、计分与逐渐加速
俄罗斯方块支持对齐辅助、旋转、移动、消行与等级加速
篮球支持重力滚动、拖拽投篮与 45 秒计分
打砖块、足球和坦克提供独立的街机玩法
游戏结束后可重开或恢复主屏幕
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的主屏幕游戏，确认总开关已启用。
阅读六款游戏的玩法说明，并按需调整贪吃蛇或打砖块选项。
返回主屏幕，长按底部 Search 按钮或页面指示器。
选择一款游戏并开始游玩。

changes: 新增篮球、打砖块、足球和坦克四款主屏幕小游戏。
增强俄罗斯方块的操作与对齐提示，并为打砖块加入两种砖块布局。
增强 iOS 15–18 兼容性、三语玩法说明与新版组合图标。
新增长按后选择贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块的统一游戏入口。
新增两款游戏的完整玩法、计分、加速与主屏幕恢复功能。
增强三语设置说明，并自动替换独立的 IconSnake 与 IconTetris 包。

en.name: SpringBoardGame
en.tagline: Play six Home Screen mini-games using icons from installed apps.
description: SpringBoardGame includes Snake, Tetris, Basketball, Breakout, Soccer, and Tank behind one shared long-press launcher and game selection screen.
Each game turns installed app icons into snake segments, blocks, basketballs, bricks, players, or enemies, and you can play again or restore the original Home Screen when it ends.
en.notice: 🎮 Long-press the Search button or page indicator at the bottom of the Home Screen, then choose one of six games. Installing this package automatically replaces installed IconSnake and IconTetris packages.
features: Choose from six Home Screen mini-games after a single long press
Use icons from installed apps as game elements
Snake with swipe steering, growth, scoring, and increasing speed
Tetris with alignment guides, rotation, movement, line clearing, and level speed
Basketball with gravity-driven rolling, flick shooting, and 45-second scoring
Independent arcade modes for Breakout, Soccer, and Tank
Play again or restore the Home Screen after a game
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open SpringBoardGame in Settings after installation and make sure it is enabled.
Read the instructions for all six games and adjust the Snake or Breakout options if needed.
Return to the Home Screen and long-press the Search button or page indicator.
Choose a game and start playing.

changes: Added Basketball, Breakout, Soccer, and Tank as four new Home Screen mini-games.
Improved Tetris controls and alignment guides, and added two brick layouts for Breakout.
Improved iOS 15–18 compatibility, trilingual instructions, and the combined game icon.
Added a unified launcher for choosing Snake or Tetris after a long press.
Added complete gameplay, scoring, speed progression, and Home Screen restoration for both games.
Improved trilingual instructions and automatically replaced the standalone IconSnake and IconTetris packages.
